dialogues.speaker: Honglang
dialogues.text: Every time there's trouble, they send me to fix it...

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: There are a bunch of randomly distributed wind currents in this Domain. Some of them even collide with each other, forming a zone impassable via flight.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: It's also pretty much impossible to force your way through these wind currents using a wind glider.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: However, we have also discovered some mechanisms in this Domain. Activating them seems to affect some wind currents...

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: We think that if we can make smart use of these mechanisms, it should make exploring this Domain a heck of a lot easier...

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: However, there's also a bunch of monsters from who-knows-where skulking around in this Domain...

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: So please, take extra care while exploring this Domain, Traveler.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: Me? I'm just a regular old adventurer, until Lan put me in charge of exploring unknown Domains of this type... *sigh*

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: She said something about trusting my abilities and believing that I would do great things.

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: But I think she just wanted to find someone who was free to take charge of this thankless task... It could have been anyone!

response.speaker: Honglang
response.text: I'll leave exploring this Domain to you while I get your payment ready.
